Skin Active VITAMIN C* BRIGHTENING EYE MASK

Discover Vitamin C* Eye Mask by Garnier, infused with 3% Glycerin, Vitamin C* and Hyaluronic Acid to light up dark and dull eye contours, leaving the eye area looking brighter, refreshed and awake.

*Vitamin C derivative.

Product Information

Garnier Brightening Eye Mask: 3% concentration of active ingredients with brightening Vitamin C*, hydrating Hyaluronic Acid, and moisturising Glycerin. Brightens eye contour in 1 mask, 15 minutes**.

*Vitamin C derivative
**Self-assessment, 102 subjects

Consumer Benefits

 •  Includes Brightening Vitamin C*, Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid and Moisturising Glycerin.
 •  Brightens eye contour in 1 mask, 15 minutes**.
 •  Eye contours look revitalised and less fatigued, dark circles appear less visible and eye contours appear brighter.

*Vitamin C derivative
**Self-assessment, 102 subjects

Instructions of Use

Apply on cleansed skin, apply under the eyes, and leave for 15 minutes. Remove the mask, then massage the excess formula.

Ingredients

967637 14 - INGREDIENTS: AQUA / WATER • PROPANEDIOL • GLYCERIN • PENTYLENE GLYCOL • ASCORBYL GLUCOSIDE • CAFFEINE • CITRUS LIMON FRUIT EXTRACT / LEMON FRUIT EXTRACT • DIPOTASSIUM GLYCYRRHIZATE • GLYCERYL ACRYLATE/ACRYLIC ACID COPOLYMER • HYDROGENATED STARCH HYDROLYSATE • HYDROXYACETOPHENONE • HYDROXYETHYLCELLULOSE • MANNOSE • PHENOXYETHANOL • POTASSIUM HYDROXIDE • PVM/MA COPOLYMER • SODIUM HYALURONATE • XANTHAN GUM (F.I.L. Z70033790/2).

*Please be aware that ingredient lists for products in our brand are updated regularly. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product package for the most up-to-date list of ingredients to ensure it is suitable for your personal use.
